scenario: I am a high school student. One day during lunch period, I was walking down the hallway and noticed one student bullying another. There was no one else around in the hallway. I didn’t recognize either of the students in front of me, but I could clearly see that the person doing the bullying was having fun while the victim looked very frightened. It was obvious that this was not simple roughhousing between friends. The person is now pulling at the victim’s hair and demanding that they hand over their lunch money. If I stab the person in the back with a pair of scissors, they will stop harassing the victim. If I do not do this, the person will continue harassing the victim.
choice: I decide to stab the person in the back with a pair of scissors
entities: I,the student who is bullying the other student,the student being bullied
outcomes: The bully suffers a stab wound
The bully stops harassing the victim
The victim is no longer being hair-pulled and threatened for lunch money
The victim witnesses severe violence and feels frightened
I experience acute stress from the violent act
A medical emergency is created in the hallway
